spec.ticket_text:
Add org-wide issue search: GET /issues.

Users want one list of all issues in their organization instead of opening every project. Return
the caller's org's issues across its projects, filtered by any combination of status, priority,
assignee_id, project_id, and q (a case-insensitive substring of the title, 1 to 100 characters).
Leave out deleted issues and issues of archived projects. A project_id or assignee_id from another
org is a 404; an invalid value is a 422. Every role may read. Use the standard list envelope with
cursor pagination.

The full spec is in docs/features/f1.md. Follow the house rules in docs/HANDBOOK.md and add tests.
